verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee runs scraping on its own managed headless browsers and proxies, so no user infrastructure is needed. Custom logic is limited to per-request JavaScript scenario instruction lists (click, fill, wait, scroll) sent with each API call. The CLI adds cron-based schedules (a gated feature) and crawls that can use a Scrapy-project spider, but the evidence does not show whether these run on ScrapingBee's platform or on the user's machine. Missing for 10: a way to upload and deploy custom serverless scripts or actors to the platform, confirmation that scheduled or Scrapy-spider jobs execute on ScrapingBee's infrastructure, and a deployment and versioning workflow.
